name: Awesome Academic Figures
description: Search academic figures and manage portable reference projects with the same model used by the gallery.
project_storage: Portable JSON file; browser import/export with explicit review. No server-side account or automatic synchronization.
assets: Fetch only chosen figure assets. Respect per-figure rights and verification status.
search_semantics: Topic tags combine with AND. Layout, venue, year and number combine with OR inside a field and AND across fields. Search aliases and filters share the gallery implementation.
